title.narrative: Support for the Global Executive Leadership Initiative (GELI)

description.narrative:
The Global Executive Leadership Initiative (GELI) is an innovative program for senior field leaders from across the system that focuses on development of leadership skills. GELI is a multi-donor initiative through which senior field leaders will engage in a highly interactive cutting-edge learning with an approach of bringing leaders from multiple organizations on a leadership development training. 
 
The Global Executive Leadership Initiative is located in Geneva, Switzerland and is hosted by UNOPS. More information on the GELI programs can be found on the website at www.geli.org.
